text: 经国务院批准，财政部将于2026年11月9日当周在加拿大发行人民币绿色主权债券，规模不超过40亿元人民币。具体发行安排将于发行前另行公布。（财政部网站）
text_en: With the approval of the State Council, the Ministry of Finance will issue RMB green sovereign bonds in Canada during the week of November 9, 2026, with a scale of no more than RMB 4 billion. Specific issuance arrangements will be announced separately before issuance. (Ministry of Finance website)
